items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I worked out there first with Charlie Fish Charlie Fishpine and then uh Jules Badu came in and took over the band

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: 30 years honey she's only 30 years ago

well 30 years ago yeah I went with Max Fink in in Memphis and I left Fink in Memphis and I came here and worked to work at Club Forest I worked 22 solid months at Club Forest without a stop I worked out there first with Charlie Fish Charlie Fishpine and then uh Jules Badu came in and took over the band and after Badu left Duke Yandis come in he took over the band I finished out there with Duke Yandis

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: well didn't Tony Amarica work with you there?
